performance.verdict: Campaigns dark 13 days; GBP and search holding but cannot replace paid volume.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for 13 consecutive days (Aug 6–18); 44 leads and $1,094.57 spend are entirely pre-blackout.
3-day lead signal is zero: last 3 days (Aug 16–18) vs prior 3 (Aug 13–15) both flat at 0 leads — not a dip, a full stop.
GBP actions dropped 55% week-over-week to near-zero, and IG reach collapsed -98.57%; organic support is also eroding, not compensating.
GHL shows 32 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — a pipeline intake leak independent of the spend blackout.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 then collapsed to 13 by Aug 16; directional only (known double-count), but the pattern matches the paid shutdown.

suggestions.text: Immediately confirm why Meta campaigns went dark Aug 6; reactivate or rebuild with prior $70/day baseline budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 13 consecutive days (Aug 6–18), erasing all lead volume; the last active day averaged ~$70/day and delivered a 28-day CPL of $24.88. Confirm whether campaigns were paused, budget-exhausted, or flagged, then reactivate or rebuild to restore the $70/day spend floor. Success is confirmed when daily spend registers >$50 and at least 1 lead is recorded within 3 days of reactivation (by Aug 22).

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 32 contacts logged with 0 opportunities created — leads arriving but not converting to pipeline entries.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 32 contacts in the 28-day window but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked — this is an intake process failure, not an ads problem. Review the GHL workflow automations and manual intake steps to identify where contacts are stalling before opportunity creation. Success is confirmed when newly arriving leads result in at least 1 opportunity created within 48 hours of contact entry, verified by Aug 26.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and search clicks for further decay; re-check Aug 22 if paid reactivation is delayed beyond 3 days.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 55% week-over-week and IG reach dropped 98.57%, meaning organic channels are also weakening, not holding the line. No buyer action is warranted here yet, but if paid campaigns are not reactivated by Aug 22, monitor whether GBP calls (55 over 28 days) continue to decline. Re-check this item on Aug 22 to determine if an organic support action is needed.
